coordinatorReview.reviewNotes: Trivial string-literal defect correctly classified by openspec with no unnecessary inflation. Speckit was appropriately skipped — no security surface, edge-case ambiguity, or testability concern exists here. The three ACs are complete, testable, and non-overlapping: (1) functional return value, (2) test maintenance, (3) type safety. No splits needed for a single-concern change. openspec's contribution was meaningful precisely in its restraint — confirming ACs were already concrete and not fabricating content. Minor observation: the title says 'every affected codeline' but ACs only reference getGreeting(); if other modules also referenced 'hello world' they'd be uncovered, but for this scope the function is the sole surface, so this is acceptable.
